description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to Ex. Ord. Gaz. No. 1958/32 of 18.03.2016 - Cad. Map No. 520006
reasoning: This gazette exclusively deals with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically modifying parcel numbers, land extents, and ownership details for multiple properties in the Colombo District. The content focuses entirely on land registration matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves corrections and updates to land title records without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters.
